integrity: The proof is analytic. It derives the one-factor weak-tail coefficient from the uniform far-field expansion and dominated convergence after scaling, then proves a product-tail lemma for two index-one regularly varying distribution tails. Standard one-parameter L^p boundedness is used only to control high-amplitude remainders. No numerical experiment or finite truncation is used as evidence for the limiting claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to factorized smooth angular kernels and compact tensor inputs with nonzero masses. It does not cover general nonfactorized product kernels, zero-mass inputs, second-order asymptotics, or an optimal universal endpoint constant over the full rough-kernel class.
title: Exact logarithmic endpoint law for factorized smooth product kernels
